an5.154:1.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti.
an5.154:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhū na sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ suṇanti, na sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti, na sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ dhārenti, na sakkaccaṃ dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhanti, na sakkaccaṃ attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjanti.
an5.154:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti. 3.
an5.154:2.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattanti.
an5.154:2.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhū sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ suṇanti, sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti, sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ dhārenti, sakkaccaṃ dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhanti, sakkaccaṃ attham aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjanti.
an5.154:2.4: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattantī
